rv.q: Instead, its The Lifespan of a Fact is about as engrossing and entertaining as anything you’ll find on the big screen, a streaming service or another theatrical stage.
The Lifespan of a Fact is a witty, fast-paced, comic journey into the nature of truth; or rather factual accuracy versus the big Truth.

cn.t: Critics praise this witty, fast-paced debate about truth and factual accuracy as surprisingly engrossing entertainment that defies its dry-sounding title, delivering thought-provoking sparks in an accessible, compelling production.
